# telnyx_email_template (Resource)

An email template, written in Liquid, for the subject and the HTML and text bodies of messages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_email_template" "welcome" {
  name      = "welcome"
  subject   = "Welcome, {{ first_name }}"
  html_body = "<p>Hello {{ first_name }}, thanks for signing up.</p>"
  text_body = "Hello {{ first_name }}, thanks for signing up."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and underscores only.

### Optional

- `autoescape` (Boolean) Whether HTML autoescaping is enabled for this template. When `true`, only rendered `html_body` expression output is HTML-escaped at the output boundary; `subject` and `text_body` are never autoescaped.
- `html_body` (String) Liquid template HTML body.
- `strict_variables` (Boolean) Whether strict variable validation is enabled for this template. When `true`, sends and renders that are missing a variable marked `required: true` in `variable_schema` fail with 422 naming the variable.
- `subject` (String) Liquid template subject.
- `text_body` (String) Liquid template text body.
- `variable_schema` (String) Structured variable requirements, or `null` when the template uses only the legacy `variables` array. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.
- `variables` (List of String) Persisted variable names. In `explicit` mode this array preserves the exact provided order, duplicates, and string contents; in `automatic` mode it is derived from the stored subject and bodies.
- `variables_mode` (String) `automatic` when variable names are derived from template content; `explicit` when `variables` is the exact manually managed array. One of `automatic`, `explicit`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_email_template.example <id>
```
